summary: Executed backend pytest workflow and mobile-first Expo web UI end-to-end role flows on preview URL. Core requested flows passed: admin/student auth, pending approval + approval, semester/course creation, attendance mark/update/delete, analytics, student dashboard/history/insights, developer section, and role-based tabs.

ui_bugs.component: Multiple interactive components (Chip, RoleChip, several PrimaryButton usages)
ui_bugs.issue: Missing testID coverage on many tappable controls makes automation brittle and violates testability requirement for interactive elements.

integration_issues.issue: Runtime warnings repeatedly show non-route files under app/ treated as routes (missing default export warnings for components/constants/services/types).

issues: Chip touch target minHeight is 40, below recommended 44px minimum for mobile accessibility.

react_native_issues.issue: Web console warns shadow* props are deprecated on web; migrate to boxShadow-compatible styling for web preview quality.

action_items: Move non-screen modules out of frontend/app/ route tree (or reorganize with Expo Router groups) to remove missing default export route warnings.
Add testID props to all interactive elements (buttons/chips/inputs/refresh/logout/approve/toggle/delete/developer CTA) for stable RN web/mobile automation.
Increase chip touch targets from 40 to at least 44 for mobile accessibility.
Align frontend backend URL env contract with EXPO_BACKEND_URL as per platform rule.
Remove insecure backend defaults for JWT_SECRET and DB_NAME to enforce fail-fast configuration.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/index.tsx is 1500+ lines and should be split into focused modules/screens/hooks (maintainability risk).
backend/server.py uses default fallback secrets/config (JWT_SECRET and DB_NAME), which conflicts with strict env-only fail-fast requirement.
frontend service layer currently depends on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL path while project contract specifies EXPO_BACKEND_URL usage.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* admin/student/college/semester/course entities via API and UI flows; attendance test record was cleaned up by DELETE endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_attendance_api.py as regression baseline against preview URL env. Core flows currently pass; prioritize warning cleanup and testID coverage before deeper UI automation.
rca_of_issue: Expo Router warnings occur because non-route utility/component files exist inside frontend/app directory, so router tries to register them as routes and expects default exports. Testability gap comes from missing testIDs on many interactive controls in index.tsx and related components.
